description: Ligne SNCF traversant les Pyrénées-Atlantiques is a dataset listed in Data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Data64. Lignes SNCF traversant les Pyrénées-Atlantiques. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are deplacement, transports, sncf, train, vivre dans le 64. The portal shows 6 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-07-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-le64-fr-portal.
